# tactility-cmakelists-version: 1
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

if (NOT DEFINED ENV{TACTILITY_SDK_PATH})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "TACTILITY_SDK_PATH environment variable is not set")
endif()

get_filename_component(TACTILITY_SDK_PATH "$ENV{TACTILITY_SDK_PATH}" ABSOLUTE)
include("${TACTILITY_SDK_PATH}/TactilitySDK.cmake")

tactility_project_pre(dices)

# The Rust core (dices-badge) and its std libraries, generated by
# badge/app/build-rust.sh. Must be set BEFORE project(): component
# subdirectories (main/) snapshot root scope variables at add_subdirectory
# time, and main/ links the staticlib into the normal dices.elf as well.
set(LINK_CMAKE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/generated/link.cmake")
if(NOT EXISTS "${LINK_CMAKE}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "${LINK_CMAKE} not found: run badge/app/build-rust.sh first")
endif()
include("${LINK_CMAKE}")

project(dices)

# Consumed by the SDK's project_elf() (the relocatable dices.app.elf link):
# the whole-archive section is our code, the group is whatever Rust std it
# needs (unused members are dropped; everything the OS provides stays
# undefined for the loader to resolve).
set(ELF_LIBS
    "-Wl,--whole-archive"
    "${DICES_STATICLIB}"
    "-Wl,--no-whole-archive"
    ${DICES_LINK_LIBS}
)

tactility_project_post(dices)
